gen-gf-domine-fs-asap: Tall, rounded bowls like blown glass bulbs give Domine its literary look. Asap follows in sans, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, so shrinking the heading would let the body take over.
gen-gf-domine-fs-epilogue: Domine brings soft-metal curves that thicken gently, while Epilogue's wire-thin, monoline sans-serif strokes look like bent pipe cleaner. That gap is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-domine-fs-fira-sans: Domine writes like a dip pen used gently. Fira Sans sits beneath it with wide-mouthed s curves and a generous x-height, drawn with no pressure swell at the corners, so a slightly larger size is a fine suggestion.
gen-gf-domine-fs-public-sans: Domine has a literary voice, with mellow thick-thin shifts in its curves. Public Sans is hefty and low in contrast, with broad open counters, so the two read as a serif and a plain sans taking turns.
gen-gf-domine-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and heavy through the middle of each line, its letters held open rather than curled shut. And Domine does what it does best up top, a light swell in each bowl like pressed glass, while the sans below simply carries text.
gen-gf-domine-manrope: Warm ink above, clean wire below. Domine's soft, restrained thick-thin gives way to Manrope, whose plain sans line runs parallel through every curve with bright open mouths, so long text slides along without snagging.
gen-gf-domine-montserrat: Montserrat glides along like wire, with oversized counters on the e and a. Domine's gentle stroke modulation sits above that ballpoint-plain line, so the serif heading and plain sans body trade texture for texture.
gen-gf-domine-satoshi: Authoritative, in a literary way, is how Domine comes across, with a faint weight shift between upstrokes and downstrokes. Satoshi follows in sans-serif with a soaring x-height and one uninterrupted line width on every letter.
gen-gf-domine-switzer: Switzer is a plain sans of tubular, wire-like letters with a tall waist line and c tips that never creep toward touching. Beside Domine's tall bowls, it feels crisp and friendly.
